name: io.github.Fashad-Ahmed/universal-db-mcp
description: Security-first, multi-database MCP server for PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, and DuckDB with 8-layer SQL injection prevention, read-only-by-default access, dry-run mode, and table allowlists.

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a SQLite database file

environmentVariables.name: DUCKDB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a DuckDB file, or :memory:

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL (default: false)
